s.g: (Pakistan) A village or revenue estate.
Of, belonging to, or relating to Mozambique or its people.
A native or inhabitant of Mozambique, or a descendant of such person.
A native or inhabitant of Mozambique; a Mozambican.
Any of various kinds of dress material.
Of or pertaining to the Mozarabs or their culture.
By analogy with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, a musical virtuoso.
By extension, a virtuoso in any field.
(music) Of or relating to, or characteristic of, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart or his music.
One who appreciates or studies the music of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
A musician regarded as a skilled interpreter and performer of Mozart's music.
A male servant, especially an attendant to a bullfighter.
A title of respect for a young man (usually unmarried) with or without a name used.
An unmarried man, a boy.
Shaggy; hairy.
Musty; starting to decay; tainted.
Faded; dingy.
Tough, as fruit when frostbitten.
(archaic) Muggy.
(Australia, slang, transitive) To jinx or give bad luck to.

(uncountable, slang, African-American Vernacular) Money.

mozzie.f: (UK, Australia, New Zealand) Alternative form of mossie (“mosquito”).
